title: Elodie and the Cipher
author: Kestrel Brightwater
blurb: Dominic Winterbourne, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
